The '''Imperial Colonization Board''', abbreviated to the '''ICB''', was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] department responsible for the overseeing the colonies and was based on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
In [[2 ABY/Legends|37:4:21]], it reported via the [[Imperial HoloVision]] that the [[Kammia]] colony of [[Drynn system]] had been wiped out by a mysterious virus. In fact, the world had been conquered by the [[Ssi-ruu]].
